featureName: Decouple Cavity Success from Linear Registration Failure

algorithmSpecification.problemStatement: Registration failure previously rolled back cavity commits because isRegistrationAcceptedForCommit rejected unkeyed results when prior registration keys existed.

inputs.name: cavityResult
inputs.description: Committed upstream cavity tool and bodies

inputs.name: registrationState
inputs.description: Derived registration state (generated, blocked, or failed)

outputs.name: finalResult
outputs.description: Decoupled final mold result with active bodies and non-blocking registration warnings

guarantees: Cavity success commits independently of registration outcome
Registration failure produces non-blocking warnings while preserving visible cavity bodies
Export returns valid cavity/sprue bodies when registration is unavailable
